# Checkliste Web-Barrierefreiheit

> An interactive German-language checklist by Moritz Vollmer for reviewing central WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA requirements.

## Canonical Page

- https://checkliste.moritzvollmer.de/

## Purpose and Scope

The checklist helps identify common accessibility barriers and document review progress. Each check includes a concise explanation, a practical test, its WCAG reference, and, where useful, a safer implementation note.

Completing every item is not proof of WCAG conformance and does not replace a defined audit scope, representative sampling, suitable automated and manual tests, or testing with people with disabilities.

## Primary Sources

- WCAG 2.2 Quick Reference: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/quickref/
- WAI Easy Checks: https://www.w3.org/WAI/test-evaluate/easy-checks/
- WCAG-EM: https://www.w3.org/WAI/test-evaluate/conformance/wcag-em/

## Author

- Moritz Vollmer: https://moritzvollmer.de/
